deepseek-v4.1-flash.description: Code-specialized model for implementing well-scoped backend logic, CLI tools, unit tests, and isolated bug fixes where requirements are clear. Not suitable for cross-cutting architectural redesigns or multi-module orchestration.

mimo-v2.6-flash.description: Low-latency flash model for quick iterative edits, localized code adjustments, and routine scripting within a single module. Not suitable for new feature architectures, SDK integrations, or multi-file changes.

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.description: High-reasoning contributor model for integrating new subsystems, cross-module feature implementation, SDK adapters, and complex code reviews that must preserve existing codebase conventions.

step-5-preview-free.description: Free-tier preview model for standalone utility scripts, simple data transformations, and small helper functions with no external system coupling.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.description: Free-tier preview model for summarizing, cross-referencing, or updating large markdown documentation sets and specification files without modifying application code.

poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free.description: Zero-reasoning free model exclusively for mechanical text edits: fixing typos, adjusting comments, or applying formatting and lint cleanups.

inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante:free.description: Zero-reasoning free flash model for trivial one-line lookups, config flag toggles, and string replacements requiring no control-flow changes.

inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash:free.description: Free-tier general coding model for straightforward bug fixes and small self-contained functions when zero-cost execution is explicitly requested.

stealth/glyph-cluster:free.description: Free-tier reasoning model for self-contained algorithmic puzzles, data structure implementations, and mathematical logic when zero-cost execution is preferred.

gpt-6-luna.description: Frontier multi-step reasoning model for complex system architecture, multi-file feature and workflow integration, concurrency, state machines, and cross-cutting refactoring across multiple components.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.description: Lightweight model for small documentation edits, README updates, configuration tweaks, and minor single-function fixes.

gemini-3.8-flash.description: Fast full-stack model for standard web UI components, REST API handlers, and CRUD feature development following established patterns.

gemini-4-argon.description: Advanced reasoning model for formal specification synthesis, security and invariant verification, and greenfield system design from architectural specs.

mimo-v2.6-pro.description: Production refactoring model for hardening existing services, migrating APIs, and updating type contracts across interconnected modules.
